purpose: Minimal durable checkpoint for replacing the designated Lead ChatGPT when a chat is near context limits, visibly degraded, unavailable, or explicitly superseded. E:/memeTrader remains the continuity source; chat memory is never the sole source.
rollover_triggers: Lead ChatGPT explicitly reports context-limit/continuity risk
current Lead chat becomes visibly slow/degraded enough to impair useful work
direct read/send proves the current Lead chat is unavailable or 404
user explicitly asks to replace the Lead chat
do_not_rollover_for: a desire to run parallel implementation
bootstrap_contract: New Lead is read-only toward active business-code implementation unless explicitly taking ownership at a clean boundary.
New Lead must identify the current active cycle from CHATGPT_CODEX_SYNC_STATE.json, not from this rollover file if they differ.
New Lead must restate internally the North Star: genuine forward, executable, cost-adjusted, risk-adjusted profitability; no future-data/backfilled winners; Live locked.
New Lead must preserve the recovered historical user requirements and efficiency rules; it must not restart completed work or turn historical ideas into active scope without promotion.
New Lead must verify the Codex execution thread id and current workspace facts before sending implementation-facing advice.
Only after successful boot validation may the routing pointer/contact card be rebound from old Lead id to new Lead id. Until then the old binding remains authoritative.
After rebind, the old Lead is SUPERSEDED and must not continue issuing implementation-facing instructions.
